exposure: compliance with a checklist-based protocol for oxytocin administration
cohort: 86,786 pregnant women undergoing term (> 37 weeks) induction of labor
finding: Adherence to the oxytocin administration protocol was associated with a decrease in postpartum hemorrhage but an increased risk of delivery by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Adherence to an oxytocin administration protocol was associated with a decrease in postpartum hemorrhage but an increased risk of delivery by cesarean section.
